description: Permanently deletes a security group and all its rules. Ask the user first. Refused for the default group, and for a group any machine still uses: the refusal names those machines, and set_instance_security_groups takes it off them first. Get the id from list_security_groups.

id.description: The group to delete: an id from list_security_groups.

name: delete_security_group
title: Delete security group
